param([string]$Repository, [string]$Scope, [string]$ShellLabel, [switch]$UnitOnly)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$paths = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Repository -Filter 'WinAudioClean*.ps1' -File | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
$paths += @('tests/WinAudioClean.OutputInteraction.Tests.ps1', 'tests/fixtures/NativeProcessFixture.cs', 'tests/fixtures/New-NativeProcessFixture.ps1', 'tests/fixtures/TestProcess.ps1')
$before = @(foreach ($path in $paths) { [ordered]@{ path = $path; sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Repository $path) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash } })
$directory = Join-Path $Repository '.wac-local/WAC-M3-05/output-focused'
$log = Join-Path $directory ($Scope + '-' + $ShellLabel + '.log')
$metadata = Join-Path $directory ($Scope + '-' + $ShellLabel + '.json')
Import-Module (Join-Path $Repository '.wac-local/Modules/Pester/5.7.1/Pester.psd1') -Force
$started = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
$parameters = @{ Path = Join-Path $Repository 'tests/WinAudioClean.OutputInteraction.Tests.ps1'; Output = 'Detailed'; PassThru = $true }
if ($UnitOnly) { $parameters.Tag = 'Unit' }
$capture = @(Invoke-Pester @parameters *>&1)
$result = @($capture | Where-Object { $_ -is [Pester.Run] })[0]
$capture | Where-Object { $_ -isnot [Pester.Run] } | Out-File -LiteralPath $log -Encoding utf8 -Width 300
$code = 0
if ($null -eq $result -or $result.PassedCount -eq 0 -or $result.FailedCount -gt 0 -or $result.FailedContainersCount -gt 0 -or $result.FailedBlocksCount -gt 0) { $code = 1 }
$after = @(foreach ($path in $before) { [ordered]@{ path = $path.path; sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Repository $path.path) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash } })
$record = [ordered]@{
    scope = $(if ($UnitOnly) { 'OutputInteraction Pester unit-only' } else { 'OutputInteraction Pester entire new suite' })
    shellLabel = $ShellLabel; shellVersion = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString(); pesterVersion = (Get-Module Pester).Version.ToString()
    startedUtc = $started; finishedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); exitCode = $code
    passed = $result.PassedCount; failed = $result.FailedCount; skipped = $result.SkippedCount; notRun = $result.NotRunCount; total = $result.TotalCount
    failedContainers = $result.FailedContainersCount; failedBlocks = $result.FailedBlocksCount
    sourcesBefore = $before; sourcesAfter = $after; sourceUnchanged = (($before | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) -eq ($after | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
    rawLogSha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $log -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
    command = @((Get-Process -Id $PID).Path, '-NoLogo', '-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', (Join-Path $directory 'Invoke-Focused.ps1'), '-Repository', $Repository, '-Scope', $Scope, '-ShellLabel', $ShellLabel)
    failures = @($result.Tests | Where-Object { $_.Result -eq 'Failed' } | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ name = $_.ExpandedName; message = ($_.ErrorRecord.Exception.Message -join '; ') } })
}
if ($UnitOnly) { $record.command += '-UnitOnly' }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($metadata, (($record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 14) + [Environment]::NewLine), [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
$record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 -Compress
exit $code

harnesses.source:
param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ResultPath)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$repo = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..')).Path
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
$paths = @('WinAudioClean.Output.ps1', 'tests/WinAudioClean.OutputLayout.Tests.ps1', 'WinAudioClean.ps1', 'WinAudioClean.IO.ps1')
$before = [ordered]@{}
foreach ($path in $paths) { $before[$path] = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash }
Import-Module (Join-Path $repo '.wac-local/Modules/Pester/5.7.1/Pester.psd1') -Force
Import-Module (Join-Path $repo '.wac-local/Modules/PSScriptAnalyzer/1.24.0/PSScriptAnalyzer.psd1') -Force
$safety = @('PSUseCompatibleSyntax', 'PSAvoidUsingInvokeExpression', 'PSAvoidUsingEmptyCatchBlock',
    'PSAvoidUsingPlainTextForPassword', 'PSAvoidUsingConvertToSecureStringWithPlainText',
    'PSAvoidUsingUsernameAndPasswordParams', 'PSAvoidUsingBrokenHashAlgorithms')
$findings = @(foreach ($path in $paths[0..1]) {
    $tokens = $null; $errors = $null
    [void][Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Join-Path $repo $path), [ref]$tokens, [ref]$errors)
    if ($errors.Count -gt 0) { throw ($errors | Out-String) }
    Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path $path -Settings (Join-Path $repo 'scripts/PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1')
})
$gating = @($findings | Where-Object { $_.Severity -eq 'Error' -or $_.RuleName -in $safety })
if ($gating.Count -gt 0) { throw ($gating | Out-String) }
$config = New-PesterConfiguration
$config.Run.Path = Join-Path $repo 'tests/WinAudioClean.OutputLayout.Tests.ps1'
$config.Run.PassThru = $true
$config.Output.Verbosity = 'Detailed'
$result = Invoke-Pester -Configuration $config
$after = [ordered]@{}
foreach ($path in $paths) { $after[$path] = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash }
$record = [ordered]@{ shellVersion = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString(); sourceBefore = $before; sourceAfter = $after
    passed = $result.PassedCount; failed = $result.FailedCount; skipped = $result.SkippedCount
    notRun = $result.NotRunCount; total = $result.TotalCount; durationSeconds = $result.Duration.TotalSeconds
    ownSourcesStable = ($before[$paths[0]] -eq $after[$paths[0]] -and $before[$paths[1]] -eq $after[$paths[1]])
    analyzerGatingFindings = $gating.Count }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($ResultPath, ($record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) + "`r`n", [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
if ($result.FailedCount -gt 0 -or -not $record.ownSourcesStable) { exit 1 }
exit 0

param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ResultPath)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$repo = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..')).Path
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
$paths = @('tests/WinAudioClean.Preview.Tests.ps1', 'WinAudioClean.ps1', 'WinAudioClean.IO.ps1',
    'WinAudioClean.Output.ps1', 'WinAudioClean.Preview.ps1')
$before = [ordered]@{}
foreach ($path in $paths) { $before[$path] = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash }
Import-Module (Join-Path $repo '.wac-local/Modules/Pester/5.7.1/Pester.psd1') -Force
$config = New-PesterConfiguration
$config.Run.Path = Join-Path $repo 'tests/WinAudioClean.Preview.Tests.ps1'
$config.Run.PassThru = $true
$config.Filter.FullName = '*settles and releases Preview leases when output organization fails*'
$config.Output.Verbosity = 'Detailed'
$result = Invoke-Pester -Configuration $config
$after = [ordered]@{}
$stable = $true
foreach ($path in $paths) { $after[$path] = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; if ($before[$path] -ne $after[$path]) { $stable = $false } }
$record = [ordered]@{ shellVersion = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString(); sourceBefore = $before; sourceAfter = $after
    passed = $result.PassedCount; failed = $result.FailedCount; skipped = $result.SkippedCount
    notRun = $result.NotRunCount; total = $result.TotalCount; durationSeconds = $result.Duration.TotalSeconds
    sourcesStable = $stable; filter = $config.Filter.FullName.Value }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($ResultPath, ($record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) + "`r`n", [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
if ($result.FailedCount -gt 0 -or $result.PassedCount -ne 2 -or -not $stable) { exit 1 }
exit 0
